title: Non-surgical hip fracture treatment
description: Non-surgical hip fracture treatment is an outpatient procedure where your doctor treats your broken hip without surgery. However, it's important to know that most hip fractures require surgery to heal properly because the hip joint must be precisely aligned. If your fracture is truly stable and non-displaced (the bone pieces are properly aligned), your doctor might treat it with bed rest, physical therapy, and protective padding. You'll use crutches or a walker and avoid weight-bearing on the affected leg. Pain medication and ice help manage discomfort. Your doctor will monitor your healing closely with periodic X-rays. Physical therapy is crucial to prevent blood clots and maintain muscle strength.
